commands.name: budget-unlimited
commands.description: on|off: unattended mode. No time budget stops the work, and a turn that ends with clm tasks open is resumed automatically, up to 50 times in a row until you type a prompt. CLAUDE_TIME_BUDGET_UNLIMITED=1 in the environment turns it on too.
commands.output: Unlimited mode is off: the time budget stops the work as usual.

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Open a new clm tracker task and declare how long it will take, or pass task with an existing issue id to resume or re-estimate that task. The harness scales the estimate by how far past estimates ran, shows the budget to the user, and asks for a report at 1/3, 1/2, 2/3 and 5/6 of it.

tools.name: report
tools.description: File a progress report against the time budget: what is verified done, what is open, and the extra minutes the open items need. The harness projects the finish from it.

tools.name: grant
tools.description: Give a running subagent more minutes from now on its time budget, after reading its report.

tools.name: stay_awake
tools.description: Keep the Mac awake with the lid closed for the next N minutes (max 240 per call; 0 lets it sleep again). Call it again before the deadline to extend. A root daemon applies it within a minute, and only while the battery is at 20% or more or on AC power.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
